protocol_change: new development-only support protocol after the V1 split audit; V1 artifacts remain historical and are not pooled with V2 results
title: Policy-aligned multi-horizon HMC action-risk filter with support-stratified groups

suite.family_source: same Issue #55 v2 development family matrix
suite.family_split: fixed condition-stratified split over 16 paired sensor groups; TRAIN=10 groups, VALIDATION=3 groups, EVALUATION=3 groups; every sensor pair remains in one split
suite.split_algorithm: canonical family roster order grouped by consecutive sensor pairs; fixed preregistered group labels

label_semantics.requested_command: catalogue command submitted as an advisory HMC proposal
label_semantics.executed_command: command digest confirmed by the plant receipt
label_semantics.persistence: the final command remains the HMC safe-hold baseline on later no-proposal cycles
label_semantics.event: any target crosses a frozen bound during the selected executed-command horizon
label_semantics.exposure: sum of normalized bound crossings during the selected executed-command horizon
label_semantics.maximum_crossing: maximum normalized bound crossing during the selected executed-command horizon
label_semantics.expected_maximum_crossing: event probability multiplied by the calibrated conditional maximum upper bound

features.source: verified operational snapshot projection plus frozen catalogue command
features.base_layout: V2 708-feature public observable projection retained as an initial baseline
prohibited_inputs: fault labels or future fault schedule
validation or evaluation labels at runtime

model.event_baseline: regularized logistic regression with training-only class weighting
model.severity_baseline: positive-event log1p regression with one-sided validation calibration
model.calibration: validation-only monotonic probability calibration; every calibrated horizon requires both event classes; positive-severity upper residuals require positive support
model.calibration_method: centered/scaled monotonic Platt fit with fixed slope ridge 1e-4 and deterministic backtracking

risk_policy.immediate_event_veto: event probability only when the 4-step validation-calibrated event upper bound exceeds the event limit
risk_policy.remaining_maximum_veto: event probability multiplied by the remaining-horizon conditional maximum upper bound exceeds the maximum limit
risk_policy.utility: existing Issue #55 point-model score among candidates passing every risk horizon
risk_policy.abstain: no candidate passes or required history is incomplete
risk_policy.hmc_fallback: no proposal; HMC retains its authoritative safe-hold baseline

metrics.primary: paired true-plant safety exposure for risk_filtered_point_v3 versus rules_only_common_window
metrics.bootstrap: 10,000 deterministic paired condition-group resamples using SHA256 seed 560057

gates.safety: risk_filtered_point_v3 exposure point and 95% upper paired difference <= rules_only_common_window
gates.honest_negative_rule: failed utility or calibration is published and never repaired with evaluation-derived thresholds

reproducibility.dirty_worktree: comparative evaluation refuses dirty source worktree
reproducibility.artifact_rule: source, contract, manifest, features, labels, model, calibration, traces, decisions, and results are SHA-256 bound

non_goals: no HMC, physics, safety-core, capability, trace, or replay changes
no deployment, qualification, certification, hardware, or real-world safety claim
no post-hoc threshold changes using evaluation behavior
no use of protected final-suite data to design the development split
